thread:
leo: quick follow-up from today's AH re: the new spend holdback and vendor catalog. my team uses a handful of infra vendors every sprint. two asks: 1) can we get preapproval so small buys don't hit procurement each time? 2) did p-card caps change? cc @camille @rahul

camille (CFO): short answers: runway ~15 months with current plan. we're instituting a 10% discretionary holdback on non-headcount spend for the next quarter to preserve runway. preapproved vendor catalog is the intended workaround for frequent small infra buys. p-card caps adjusted slightly. details below.

leo: what does "preapproved vendor catalog" mean in practice?

rahul (procurement): catalog means we pre-vet a vendor (security + commercial) and add them to the internal list. purchases from cataloged vendors up to $7k can be self-served (no procurement ticket) if you attach the catalog vendor ID in the Spend Request metadata. above $7k still needs procurement review. to request cataloging, use the Vendor Catalog Request form (link below) with vendor details and a short justification.

anya: can teams request a batch preapproval for a set of vendor SKUs we use every sprint?

rahul (procurement): yes  include the SKU list and expected monthly volume in the catalog request. we'll fast-track group requests; expected turnaround for catalog decisions = 5 business days if packet complete. incomplete packets will pause review.

leo: p-card caps?

camille (CFO): p-card single-transaction cap is $3k default; rolling monthly cap = $10k. teams on critical infra work can request a project-level increase (via Spend Request) with two approvers listed. p-cards cannot be used for new-vendor onboarding fees > $3k.

mika (finance): note: automated guardrails will DM cardholders at 80% of monthly cap and email their manager. approvers will get an alert on attempted high-value swipes.

leo: what about customer-blocking emergencies that need immediate GPU time?

ops-funding-bot: ops contingency available up to $12k for verified customer-impact incidents. Submit Spend Request tag "catalog-expedite" + ping @rahul + @ops-funding-bot. procurement can issue a temporary PO or approve a p-card exception up to $10k while onboarding completes. CFO approval if > $25k. target unblock SLA = 48 hours for validated incidents.

camille (CFO): final: Vendor Catalog Request form: https://internal.redwood.com/vendor-catalog (internal). Spend Request: https://internal.redwood.com/spend-request. rahul will host a 30-min office hour next Tue 11:00-11:30 to walk through catalog requests.

leo: perfect, i'll start filing catalog requests for our infra vendors. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
